name: zero-day
about: §4R L2: a fold with a zero — one campaign spent nothing and showed nowhere, another spent with no lead, so neither has a cost per lead.

output.headline: On November 3, 2026, 2 campaigns ran and brought in no leads, with all $42.10 in spend and all 19 clicks coming from Dedicated night runs.
points: Dedicated night runs spent $42.10 across 2,300 impressions and 19 clicks at a 0.8% click rate, but produced no leads, so there is no cost per lead to report.
Regional Class A — Joliet served no impressions, recorded no clicks, and spent $0.00 — it was effectively idle on this day, with no leads and no cost per lead.
November 2026 has 28 days left; Meta is the only platform with spend so far this month, at $42.10.

The mature week-of-2026-09-28 cohort is the strongest on record: 40 leads, 36 contacted (90.0%), 20 converted to applicants (50.0%), 12 applied (30.0%), 5 hired (12.5%), and 9 lost after conversion (22.5%).
The mature week-of-2026-09-21 cohort shows 38 leads, 33 contacted (86.8%), 17 converted (44.7%), 10 applied (26.3%), 4 hired (10.5%), and 8 lost after conversion (21.1%).

The week-of-2026-10-26 cohort has 12 leads — 9 contacted, 3 converted, 1 applied, 1 lost after conversion, and no hires yet — but it is too young to judge; leads are still moving through the pipeline. Qualified leads and leads lost before conversion are not recorded in the system.
